`python3 roster.py inactive` now lists every learner whose last login was 14 or more days ago. Run today (2026-10-04) against `learners.json`, it returns:

```
L-002  Ben Whitlock         ben.w@example.org        ALG1
L-004  Dara Novak           dara@example.org         CHEM2,HIST1
```

I checked the cutoff: a learner who last logged in exactly 14 days ago is included, and one at 13 days is not. There is no test file in the project, so that check was a one-off run rather than a saved test.

- **Output format:** it is the same as `list` and `course` (id, name, email, courses), so it does not show the last login date or days inactive.
- **Threshold:** the 14 days is a constant, `INACTIVITY_THRESHOLD`, in `roster.py`, not a command-line argument.
- **README:** I added the command to the usage block and an "Inactive learner" entry to the glossary.
